# House meeting, September 6, 2026

Present: Jordan, Sam, and Priya from Orchard Lane (by phone for the roof item).

## Roof

Three quotes came in for replacing the back slope over the kitchen:

- Kestrel Exteriors: $16,250, can start in November, 10-year workmanship warranty.
- Brightline Roofing: $14,800, can start the week of October 19, 15-year workmanship warranty.
- Halbrook Roof & Gutter: $13,900, but no start date before spring and no written warranty.

Decision: go with Brightline Roofing. Cheaper than Kestrel, sooner than Halbrook, and the longest warranty. Orchard Lane agreed to cover half because the leak reaches the shared wall. Jordan pays the deposit and sends Priya the receipt.
